description_text:
Detailed and realistic male outfit 45
File formats provided are OBJ, FBX & DAE
 Texture maps: Diffuse: 8192x8192px, Normal: 4096x4096px
Clothing will eventually fit most avatars with minor adjustments.
How to fit the clothing to DAZ characters:

  - Dial Genesis 8 Male Arms Up-Down to -45% and Legs Spread to -5% in Parameters

  - Go into bone edit mode, and when bones are visible select one, right click and go edit -> bake joint rotations

  - Use the transfer utility, set source item shape to current and add a smoothing modifier.

  - Save the clothing to your library. 

  - Clear the scene, add G8 Male again and add the outfit, it should now fit the zero-posed character.

Hope this helps,
Enjoy!

description_text:
- Low-poly and optimised for game engines

  - Rigged: inverse kinematics with control joints

  - Legs are rigged as pistons with Damped Track bone constraint

  - Fully animated walk cycle, loopable (e.g. see youtube preview)

  - 4K PBR Textures: Albedo, Metalness, Roughness, Specular, Transparency and Normal

  - All textures are in .PNG format and are packed into .blend file & a separate .zip file

  - Each part is a separate object with a proper name

  - Model consists of only quad-polygons, no N-gons

  - All UV's are non-overlapping and are unwrapped onto a single texture atlas

  - Model has a unified general PBR material assembled in Quixel Mixer

  - Rendered in real time with EEVEE renderer in Blender

  - The HDRI used for render is not included

  - Design inspired by Westworld Season 3

  - Fell free to contact me for additional infromation and have a great day!

PROPS SET for POSER-DAZ James-Simon-Michael4 STANDARD CHARACTERS. CHARACTERS NOT INCLUDED. [DAZ is a free Software].___________________________________________Greek Trireme Oarsman Props Set with 6 typical Greek Trireme Oarsman props. All 3D models ready for POSER James and Simon G2 and DAZ Michael 4. Faithful and accurate Reconstruction. C4D, 3DS, OBJ, POSER, DAZ, VUE6-7-8-9-10!_____________________________________________SmartCgArt is member of the Archaeological Institute of America [AIA].
Real World Scale Model [SmartCgArt Real World System]. Quads [C4D; OBJ; POSER/DAZ] & Tris [VUE;3DS].
Collection of 6 3D Models with 15 Photoreal and Alternate textures.3 complete Props Sets ready to be used with POSER [James, Simon G2] and DAZ [Michael 4 character][DAZ is a free Software].
Faithful and accurate Reconstruction of an Ancient Greece Trireme Oarsman Props Set to create an Ancient Greece Trireme Oarsman, according to the Scientific Data and the Archaeological Evidence.
Greek Triremes were designed so that it was easy to change crew and oarsmen rapidly. Crew and oarsmen could also carry oars, tholepin grommets, cushions and all the other props with them, when changing the ship, by leaving the first harbour with the first ship and by reaching another harbour where a second ship was ready to receive a new crew.
Trireme Oars were ca. 4.5 m in length. Tholepin grommets were of leather or rope.Trireme Oars Blades were flat.
In the package you will find:1- typical Ancient Greek Kilt Aa [Standard];2- typical Ancient Greek Kilt Ab [Sculpted];3- 1 Trireme Oar [4.5 m];4- 1 Rope Tholepin Grommet;5- 1 Cushion;6- 1 Headband;7- Complete SET ready for POSER 6 and Up JAMES character;8- Complete SET ready for DAZ MICHAEL 4 character;9- Complete SET ready for POSER 7 and Up SIMON G2 character;10- 15 Hi-Quality Hi-Def PhotoReal Textures [2072x2072; 1000x1000; 512x512; etc.];11- Alternate Textures to create different types of elements;12- Real World Scale SmartCgArt Man Reference System with models [C4D, VUE, 3DS, OBJ, DXF].
All the Models are prepared Hi-DEF and Photoreal, perfect for any type of Rendering!

Faithful and accurate Reconstruction of an Ancient Rome Ship-Prow Tortoise Siege Machinery to create an Ancient Rome Ship-Prow Tortoise, according to the Scientific Data and the Archaeological Evidence.

Source: Apollodorus, Poliorketika [proteichisma and tortoise like a ship's prow].

The Ship-Prow Tortoise was used by legionaries during siege against hill towns, to protect troops from heavy objects rolled downhill: tree trunks, boulders, wagons and barrels.

It was used in combination with a wood and branches fence system, to defend deep ditches [1.5 m] were the soldiers could gather, before reaching the inner section of the tortoise where they stayed safe crowded, until the moment of the direct attack.

The Wood and Branches Fence System was used also independently to protect the ditches.

description_text:
Ok . I am back , and this time with a horror product , or fantasy product , I know about the fantasy mimics creatures , first time I saw them it was in an old pc game named Nox , they where some kind of swan body with many spider legs , and tow arms in fronts with to blades , and the boxes some times turn into it , and it where so much strong , even stronger than golems , those who played the game understand that .
I thought it a creature made by the designers of the game , but later I got game named Torch light , and it is like nox but of course with more graphic , while nox contains more action that I loved nox more , in this game there is a pet and fishing holes , that you can fish kinds of fishes to feed them to your pet to transform it for a period of time to some creature , there were also treasure boxes that attacks you when you try opening it , it was not formidable like the one in Nox , but I got a fish and gave it to my pet and it transformed to this box , then I found in the instruction of this fish Makes your pet transform into a Mimic , then I knew that the Mimic is famouse creature in mythology .
Later I watched some anime named Owari no seraph , which the vampires counquered the world and they were so evil to the man kind , and enslaving them , even the kids , and they were invinceble against the human's weapons , but some team of them got some magical skills that can kill the vampires , that the heroes uses them to rebel against vampires , I do not remember any of those skills but one , the owner was training with the main hero , and summoned some large box , as soon as the hero got closer , the box opened a little and there was to glowing eyes withen it , then the hero stepped back immediatly , then I remembered the mimic , and this skill never used in the anime , because there is a new seasons because the story did not end at the last episode .
The week before I got an idea looks similar like all this , and it is this mimic that lives in trees , I still have more ideas of this creatures , but I am not sure if I will create them or not , because as you know I do not care this much about the work that brings back nothitng .

description_text:
EMT Aladin (German: Abbildende Luftgestützte Aufklärungsdrohne im Nächstbereich, airborne reconnaissance drone for close area imaging) is a small, man-portable light reconnaissance miniature unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) employed by the Bundeswehr (German Army).
An Aladin UAV of the German ArmyThe UAV can be radio-controlled via a portable control station, or fly according to previously set GPS coordinates. It features a day and night camera and video-relay. It can be transported in two suitcases, which contain the disassembled drone, and a backpack with the control station. The aircraft can be assembled and disassembled without tools in the field within five minutes.
The aircraft can be launched by hand or with a bungee catapult.
This UAV is used by the German Army in the northern part of Afghanistan. In May 2006, The Netherlands bought 10 Aladins for use in southern Afghanistan (Uruzgan), though in 2008 the Dutch program procured 24 systems of the AeroVironment Raven B.
Also Fennek reconnaissance vehicles of the German Army are equipped with Aladin UAVs.

description_text:
Mecha FriezaAfter being cut in half by his own attack and being caught in Namek's huge explosion, what remains of the still-living Frieza is salvaged and rebuilt with cybernetic enhancements by scientists under the order of King Cold; this form is referred to as Mecha Frieza (メカフリーザ) in video games. The whole of the lower half of his body and right side of his face are replaced, as is his left arm from the shoulder down, with scarring and metal accoutrements covering what little was left of his organic self. It is stated that these enhancements have made him even more powerful. However, he was never able to unleash his full power in this form, since he was quickly destroyed by Trunks.
Future TrunksTrunks first appears in chapter #331 The Young Boy of Mystery (謎の少年 Nazo no Shōnen), published in Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine on July 15, 1991.[1] Here he is a mysterious seventeen year old capable of transforming into the Super Saiyan state, who appears and singlehandedly kills Freeza and his father, King Cold.[4] Upon Goku's return from Planet Namek, Trunks confides in Goku his tragic story.[5]
As told in the stand-alone manga side story Trunks: The Story - The Lone Warrior (TRUNKS THE STORY －たったひとりの戦士－ Torankusu za Sutōrī -Tatta Hitori no Senshi-) and chapters #419 and 420,[6][7] Trunks has traveled from twenty years in the future where the world is in constant ruin due to the terror of the two androids #17 and #18 which were created by Doctor Gero, the former chief scientist of the Red Ribbon Army. By this time, Goku has succumbed to an unknown heart virus and everyone, with the exception of Gohan, has fallen at the hands of the artificial humans.[8] Trunks has been living with Bulma and secretly training with Gohan. After Gohan's inevitable death, Trunks assumes the mantle of Earth's sole protector against the artificial humans for the next three years until Bulma finishes her time machine. Once he informs Goku of the events to come, Trunks gives Goku a special medicine[8] and returns to his own time.[9]
Trunks returns to help in the present day battle against the artificial humans. With the appearance of Cell, Trunks trains with Vegeta in the Room of Spirit and Time. After Vegeta's defeat, Trunks fights Cell in his newly gained Perfect state. However, Trunks' new Super Saiyan grade proves to be ineffective so he willingly concedes. He later participates in Cell's martial arts tournament, where he is killed by Cell. After Cell's defeat, Trunks is restored with the Dragon Balls, upon which he returns to his own timeline in the future and defeats the artificial humans and Cell within his time.
Years later, Trunks encounters a new enemy known as Goku Black and is forced to retreat to the present timeline. He is shown to be able to reach Super Saiyan 2. During Goku and Goku Black's fight, Trunks' time machine is destroyed, leaving him stuck in the present era.[10] After a reunion with Gohan, who he sees content with being a family man in the presence of his wife Videl and daughter Pan, Trunks becomes encouraged to defeat Goku Black in order for the people of his own timeline to have a chance at that same happiness,[11] also having a reunion with Android #18.[12] Trunks then receives training from Vegeta, vowing to surpass both his father and Goku Black in strength.[13] Trunks then travels to the future to counter Goku Black (who is later revealed as Zamasu in Goku's body, but from another timeline),[14] dueling Zamasu (from Future Trunks' timeline) instead.[15] After his defeat, Trunks heals in the past and returns for a rematch. During the fight, Trunks becomes enraged when Goku Black blames him for all that has happened because of the use of the time machine, and transforms into an unknown Super Saiyan form. After numerous fights, including Goku Black and Zamasu fusing with the Potara earrings, Trunks gathers the energy from all remaining life on the planet into his sword and cuts Fusion Zamasu in half. Despite losing his body, Zamasu's essence began to envelop the entire universe, before being destroyed alongside the entire multiverse by that timeline's version of Zen-oh. Trunks and the others retreat to the past. Goku later invited Trunks to get Future Zen-Oh. The two go back, with Trunks and Mai bidding their farewells, returning afterward to a future timeline where Zamasu hasn't schemed his plans, and where there is an already existing Mai and Trunks, Bulma, and the comrades that were killed by Zamasu in Trunks' original universe.

description_text:
Created in Blender 2.93This model was originally designed for direct input into VRCHAT.
It will require:

  - VRCSDK3-AVATAR-2021.09.03.09.25_Public or higher

  - Dynamic Bones v.1.2.2 or higher

  - Muscle Animation Editor v.2.2 or higher (not needed for export, but may cause errors when importing .unitypackage)

  - Xiexe's Unity Shaders Rewritten

IMPORTANT NOTES:
The package has 4 scenes, split into two sections. 
The first section has Tasque and Tasque Quest. These have basic cloth simulation (Excluding the quest because it doesn't support it) in the dress. This may cause lag, so I would reccomend using the second section.   
The second section has Tasque No-Cloth and Tasque No-Cloth Quest These do not have cloth simulation, and are replaced with dynamic bones. If you do not want dynamic bones, you can remove them.
All scenes are identical, other than the quest variants having NO WHIP (as it is not supported), and the quest variants having supported VRCHAT mobile textures.
There is a thumbnail given in the files, but you can make your own with the VRCCAM :3

description_text:
Detailed and realistic male outfit 65
File formats provided are OBJ, FBX & DAE Texture maps: Diffuse: 8192x8192px, Normal: 4096x4096px
Clothing will eventually fit most avatars with minor adjustments.
How to fit the clothing to DAZ characters:

  - Dial Genesis 8 Male Arms Up-Down to -45% and Legs Spread to -5% in Parameters

  - Go into bone edit mode, and when bones are visible select one, right click and go edit -> bake joint rotations

  - Use the transfer utility, set source item shape to current and add a smoothing modifier.

  - Save the clothing to your library. 

  - Clear the scene, add G8 Male again and add the outfit, it should now fit the zero-posed character.

Hope this helps,
Enjoy!

This is a digital 3D printable model of Loki helmet
The download contains pieces of the model ready to be 3D printed on a 200 mm print bed.. All cut parts are placed on the print bed as we would print them to save you time.
SIZE
At 100% scale the model’s dimensions are approximately:
width: 172 mm
depth: 235 mm
You can scale the helmet as you wish to ensure a good fit, but we can’t guarantee that at a much smaller size the model will print well.
3D PRINTING SETTINGS
We use these settings for most of our prints:
Layer height 0.2 mm
Infill 15%
Supports 45°
For parts that are tall but have a small base, we use a 10 mm brim for better bed adhesion.
We try to make the models in a way that uses as little support material as possible.
This model is meant to be post-processed after printing. This can be gluing, sanding, painting, etc.
Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.
Do you like the model and don’t have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.

description_text:
This is a digital 3D printable model of the Goblin Slayer helmet from the Goblin Slayer.
Included Files

  - STL (cut for 200mm printer beds)

  - STL (uncut for larger printers)

  - Assembled OBJ file (for easy scaling)

All cut parts are placed on the print bed just as we would print them, saving you time.
3D Model Dimensions

  - Width: 315 mm

  - Length: 265 mm

  - Height: 337 mm

Feel free to scale the model to fit your needs. Learn more about sizing and scaling for cosplay here.
Printer Settings

  - Layer height: 0.15 mm

  - Infill: 10% gyroid pattern

  - Supports: 30° organic

  - For taller parts, use a brim for better bed adhesion

Settings may vary depending on your printer, so treat these as a starting point.
No 3D printer? No problem! Search for your local 3D printing services.
This fan-made model was brought to life by 3Demon, a team of modeling and 3D printing enthusiasts based in Prague, Czech Republic. We’ve been creating 3D printable models for over a decade, from cosplay accessories to all sorts of interesting designs.

description_text:
This is a digital 3D printable model of a Basilisk miniature for tabletop games.It was modelled based on the diary entries of Giles Grafton. Here is one of the entries concerning this model:
Trophy hunt
I have originally come to the Terragona marketplace just to replenish my food supplies and to buy some new equipment for a journey to Africa (yes, that’s how I decided to use the money I got from baron Contarini!), but as I was browsing through all the peculiar stands and stalls with merchandise from all around the world, I noticed a big tent surrounded by an aura of mystery and also a sizeable crowd of people. The sign in front of the tent read: “Monsters of the wilderness” – needless to say, it immediately caught my attention. After waiting in a line for a while (and paying a few coins as an entrance fee) I managed to get inside this odd tent, which, as it turned out, was filled with dead bodies of various animals. Some of them were mounted as wall trophies, others were stuffed or preserved in big jars. There were more than a dozen of them, but to my disappointment, most of those unfortunate creatures were actually pretty common beasts: there was a brown bear, a very old looking lion, a huge snake of some sort, all beautiful and dangerous animals, but no “monsters”. But then I saw it – in the very middle of the tent, hidden behind other exhibits and several curious onlookers, there stood a majestic, reptile-like creature with sharp teeth and tail covered in bright blue-coloured feathers. I forgot to breathe for a few moments – I was staring into the face of a basilisk.
The man who was collecting the entrance fee and who was apparently the owner of this peculiar tent, as well as the collection within it, must have noticed my sudden surprise since he approached me and with a smile on his face congratulated me on my “cultivated taste”, as he put it. He really seemed more like an artist presenting his work than a scientist studying a fascinating species (which is how I felt), but he was nonetheless very enthusiastic. I asked him where he got such a rare specimen, to which he answered that he simply bought it from a merchant from Africa. This merchant, as he told me, was running through Spain to Europe exactly because of this particular basilisk. Apparently, it was killed by a group of poachers who made their living by hunting big and valuable prey. One day, they somehow managed to kill a basilisk – and they immediately sold its corpse to the first vendor they found. It seemed like a great deal for both parties at first – but of course, there was a catch. The catch, in this case, was the fact that this almost seven feet long basilisk turned out to be just a baby. And when it disappeared, its mother came looking for her child. None of the hunters survived. The unfortunate merchant ran all the way to Europe so the mother would not find him, and he sold the corpse of her baby to the first person who was willing to buy it. I asked the man whether he wasn’t worried that the mother would track her child down, but he just laughed and explained that the basilisk was stuffed and surrounded by hundreds of different people every day – any scent his mother could follow was now long gone. I thanked him for sharing his story and made a few sketches of the creature before I left. For a while, I was thinking about stealing a feather from the basilisk’s tail, but then I decided not to. After all, I was on my way to Africa and when I thought about it – the smile on the owner’s face when he was explaining how the mother can’t ever find her child did not actually seem all that confident. 
3D PRINTING SETTINGSThe mini comes in two versions. One pre-supported and one without supports. In both cases, the mini is separate from the base.
SIZEAt 100% scale, the model is scaled to work with DnD 5e. The largest part’s dimensions are:Width approx. 34 mmLength approx. 68 mmHeight approx. 46 mmYou can scale the model as you wish.
We recommend printing these on an SLA printer. It can be printed on an FDM printer with a small nozzle at 100% but you will lose a lot of detail and the finish will not be as good by far.
Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.
Do you like the model and don't have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.
This fan-made model was brought to life by 3Demon. We are a group of modeling and 3d printing enthusiasts based in Prague, Czech Republic.Here are some links to our website and social media where you can see more of our creations:
https://3d-mon.com/links/

description_text:
You hear that? Better run my friend, this colossal creature is made to kill and destroy everything on it´s path! The Xenoteras Destroyer has arrived in 3 different forms!
First of all you will find the Standard, which is the original one, versatile and convertible. The second one is the Assault one, made for close combat with lots of extra spikes and a more menacing head. The third of them is the Spitter, who has a bio cannon emerging from what would be his mouth. Every time he fires the cannon, the chest opens to allow the energy build up for a devastating shot. Opposite to his fellows, the Spitter only has talons to defend himself in close combat, but that doesn´t mean is any softer!
What you will find here is a .ZIP file with folders containing the following:-Arms: Talons (monster size); Claws (monster size); Talons Spitter (made for second set of arms, slightly smaller than monster talons)-Heads: Standard and Assault head, the Spitter one is welded to the chest.-Legs: Standard (for Standard and Spitter); Assault; both have a posed one (left and right) which will allow to give extra dynamism.-Torsos: Standard; Assault; Spitter-Rocks: both left and right, in case you want to use the POSED LEGS-Tail-Small talons  (for the chest, you will need x4)
There is also a README FILE that contains scales for making the arms compatible with alternate tabletop models. The original size of this model is meant to be for a large monster oval base.
Please note that this model is for personal use only. If you are interested on selling my models, please contact me privately
Happy printing

description_text:
Contents: FBX, TGA Textures files, Unity 5 PackageNote that PSD and 3D working files will not be provided in this package.
Check out Toon Series at Shop3DSA! The Toon Series characters are squarish, cartoony and simple.They are also very low poly, therefore it's very suitable for mobile games. 
This pack consists of 4 heroic characters. They all very low poly, textured, rigged and animated. FX unity particles are included in the package. Note that 3d working files and texture working files are not and will not be included. 
Low poly Simple Toon Knight 
Triangle count is only 394! Textures are hand painted and available in 3 colors. They are rigged and animated. There are 14 animations altogether. Legacy and Generic Mecanim rig set up if you are using Unity game engine. Glitter FX Unity Particles is included in the Unity package. Note that the background and environment you see in the main image are not included in the package. 
See images and Youtube video for animations and model preview. 
Animations:- Idle- Walk - Run - Attack 01- Attack 02- Double Attack- Jump Attack - Cast Spell - Victory- Upset - Jump - Defend - Take damage- Die
Low poly Simple Toon Wizard/Magician
Triangle count is only 452! Textures are hand painted and available in 3 colors. They are rigged and animated. There are 16 animations altogether. Legacy and Generic Mecanim rig set up if you are using Unity game engine. Glitter FX, Projectile and Projectile Impact Unity Particles are included in the Unity package. 
Note that the background and environment you see in the main image are not included in the package. 
See images and Youtube video for animations and model preview. 
Animations:- Idle- Walk - Run - Melee Attack- Shockwave Attack- Channeling - Chanting - Projectile Attack - Cast Spell 01 - Cast Spell 02 - Victory- Upset - Jump - Defend - Take damage- Die
Low poly Simple Toon Barbarian 
Triangle count is only 526! Textures are hand painted and available in 3 colors. They are rigged and animated. There are 17 animations altogether. Legacy and Generic Mecanim rig set up if you are using Unity game engine. Weapon Claw is a separated mesh, therefore it's replaceable. FX Tornado Unity Particles is included in the Unity package. 
Note that the background and environment you see in the main image are not included in the package. 
See images and Youtube video for animations and model preview. 
Animations:- Idle- Walk - Run - Dash- Right Claw Attack- Left Claw Attack - Rapid Attack - Spin Attack - Cast Spell- Row Attack - Jump Attack - Victory- Upset - Jump - Defend - Take damage- Die
Low poly Simple Toon Barbarian 
Triangle count is only 722! ( character + crossbow + arrow) Textures are hand painted and available in 3 colors. They are rigged and animated. There are 13 animations altogether. Legacy and Generic Mecanim rig set up if you are using Unity game engine. Arrows with Fire/Freeze FX, FX Projectile and Impact Unity Particles are included in the Unity package. 
Note that the background and environment you see in the main image are not included in the package. 
See images and Youtube video for animations and model preview. 
Animations:- Idle- Walk - Run - Arrow Attack- Multiple Shots Attack - Cast Spell- Projectile Attack - Victory- Upset - Jump - Defend - Take damage- Die

Louis XIV of France
Louis XIV (5 September 1638 – 1 September 1715), known as Louis the Great (Louis le Grand) or the Sun King (le Roi-Soleil), was a monarch of the House of Bourbon who ruled as King of France from 1643 until his death in 1715. His reign of 72 years and 110 days is the longest of any monarch of a major country in European history. In the age of absolutism in Europe, Louis XIV's France was a leader in the growing centralization of power.
Louis began his personal rule of France in 1661, after the death of his chief minister, the Italian Cardinal Mazarin. An adherent of the concept of the divine right of kings, which advocates the divine origin of monarchical rule, Louis continued his predecessors' work of creating a centralized state governed from the capital. He sought to eliminate the remnants of feudalism persisting in parts of France and, by compelling many members of the nobility to inhabit his lavish Palace of Versailles (formerly a hunting lodge belonging to Louis' father), succeeded in pacifying the aristocracy, many members of which had participated in the Fronde rebellion during Louis' minority. By these means he became one of the most powerful French monarchs and consolidated a system of absolute monarchical rule in France that endured until the French Revolution.
Louis encouraged and benefited from the work of prominent political, military, and cultural figures such as Mazarin, Colbert, Louvois, the Grand Condé, Turenne, and Vauban, as well as Molière, Racine, Boileau, La Fontaine, Lully, Marais, Le Brun, Rigaud, Bossuet, Le Vau, Mansart, Charles and Claude Perrault, and Le Nôtre. Under his rule, the Edict of Nantes, which granted rights to Huguenots, was abolished. The revocation effectively forced Huguenots to emigrate or convert in a wave of dragonnades, which managed to virtually destroy the French Protestant minority.
During Louis' reign, France was the leading European power, and it fought three major wars: the Franco-Dutch War, the War of the League of Augsburg, and the War of the Spanish Succession. There were also two lesser conflicts: the War of Devolution and the War of the Reunions. Warfare defined Louis XIV's foreign policies, and his personality shaped his approach. Impelled by a mix of commerce, revenge, and pique, Louis sensed that warfare was the ideal way to enhance his glory. In peacetime he concentrated on preparing for the next war. He taught his diplomats their job was to create tactical and strategic advantages for the French military.

description_text: A male, planar head. The set includes an STL file prepared for 3D printing. It is approved for printing by Netfabb. It also includes a ZTL file with all shapes organized as independent subtools. Feel free to use it as a base mesh for further sculpting.This started as a simple anatomy exercise, where I wanted to simplify a human face. Soon I realized, that having all main anatomy features as diffrent subtools, that I can modify independently, is an incredibly nice starting point for sculpting portraits. It helps with keeping track of all main shapes.  The flow of intersecting shapes introduces an engineering quality to the sculpt.  I have found it hugely helpful. Hope You will too! Feel free to ask me any questions about the model You might have.

Low poly game model of BB8, the lovable new droid from Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Efficient geometry is used throughout the model and much care was taken to assure proper proportions and movie accuracy. 
The model is currently a group of 4 objects- the body, the body's circular plates, the head, and a few additional details. The model uses one 2048 x 2048 diffuse texture map.

description_text:
John Doe is a starter pack to help other Blender Artists to create new Characters with in minutes, his face and body can be customized in many shape and sizes, making him look different each time.
Once, you have created clothes or armour and have a complete character, he will be ready for Retopology. Bake, from the high poly model on to your low poly to produce your  game model. Now, your ready to Rig and Texture.
Morph from an average man to little person/Dwarf or even, a giant.
Alpha's (Sculpted Textures)
-Wrinkles-Veins-Skin
SHAPE KEYS: 
141(Combinations) and 18 Basis((Default)IMPORTANT NOTE:Make sure its on this, if you want to re-sculpt the surface and do NOT res-culpt at value 1and return it back Value 0 because it willbe deformed. Start a NEW Key Shape for a new Morph!
How to find it... On the right hand side, 3/4 quarters up the screen. You will come across triangle that is upside, down this is called Data Object Data from here scroll down to Shape keys.How to make it work... In the Value Bar it is 0 - 1, i.e. Eyes_SHut was at 0.5 that would make his eyes half closed.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - C4D models are grouped for easy selection & objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No cleaning up necessary, just drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

description_text:
Disclaimer -This model was made in Blender, and is only meant to work in Blender. As things like the rig may not be included in 3ds Max, Maya, or any other 3D Software. 
I’ve been a rigger for years and I’ve always been head strong about doing it all on my own making every single piece so that I knew how it all worked, but this time around I set aside that stubborn I will do it myself attitude and got into rigify. Absolutely brilliant rig, and after cracking it open I can see how customizable it can be. I do believe this will be how I handle many projects moving forward. I still think the ability to replicate these rigs is valuable in case something needs to be made from the ground up but using rigify is so quick and easy I think it will dramatically improve my workflow for character creations.
SpecificsSoftware: Origianl version made in Blender 2.79 but updated for 4.5

Included are 4k displacement, normal, diffuse, and cavity maps. The cranium, mandible, bottom teeth, and upper teeth meshes each occupy their own UDIM patch. Also in the maya file there is a VRay material and displacement set-up ready to go. You could also use the low-resolution mesh with the Normal Map to use the asset in a game engine. I am including the Ztool in case you would like to use this as a base to create a more unique skull. Great for short films or anatomy reference!

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This model was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized via ZRemesher within Zbrush. It has animation ready topology wrapped on top of the scan in Wrap3. 
This is a true human size and detailed model of a doctor-killer with a drill - character for horror settings. The model is captured in the A-pose with mesh ready for rigging and animation in all most usable 3d software.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, inside Game Engines or for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - fully quad topology

  - sufficiently clean

  - edge Loops based

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map 

  - non-overlapping UV map

  - ready for animation

  - PBR textures 8K/4K resolution: Normal, Displacement, Albedo maps

  - Cinema 4d project file and redshift shader included. You can find all PBR textures in tex folder inside cinema 4d project folder.

Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
Bronchial tree anatomy for 3d printing CFD and FEA.
A bronchus or bronchial tree is a passage or airway in the respiratory system that conducts air into the lungs. The first bronchi to branch from the trachea are the right main bronchus and the left main bronchus, also known as the primary bronchi. These are the widest and enter the lungs at each hilum, where they branch into narrower secondary bronchi or lobar bronchi, and these branch into narrower tertiary bronchi or segmental bronchi. Further divisions of the segmental bronchi are known as 4th order, 5th order, and 6th order segmental bronchi, or grouped together as subsegmental bronchi. The bronchi when too narrow to be supported by cartilage are known as bronchioles. No gas exchange takes place in the bronchi. 
Size:385*385*50mm
The model provides a 3d geometry to be used  in finite element analysis or computational fluid dynamics.
The model is provided in three formats : STL, STEP, IGES and OBJ.
3 variations are provided a watertight  solid 'filled' , a 1mm wall thickness shell and a zero thickness surface. 
The model has been simplified and optimized for 3d printing.
To be used for educational purposes and 3d printing applications.
Ideal for use in medical teaching environments.
Please contact us for any inquiries and modifications.

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. 
This is a true human size and detailed model of a adult man of Caucasian appearance dressed in a uniform of a surgical doctor. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of architectural visualization, background character, product visualization, e.g. advert banners, professional products/devices presentations, etc. 
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles) 

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures 8K diffuse, normal, specular maps 

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, as well as OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you may find in Tex folder, included into the main archive. 
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
This file includes all of the parts necessary to print your own fully posable male ball jointed doll.Two different heads are included in the file.  The photos of a printed and primed head is the HeadStyle1.
An .obj file containing all of the pieces is included, as well as a Maya (.mb) file containing everything.Then .obj files of each individual part, set up for print, is also included.Sorry they're not already STLs - I use Simplify3D which opens obj files just fine, so it's usually what I default to, and I didn't want to re-export everything.
Everything is to the same scale, so if you want to make him larger, make sure you apply the scale the same to every piece.
My printer sucks with Raft Support, and I end up with a really rough underside, so I split many of the pieces in half, (so they've got a flat side for printing) and then glue them together.  It gets the cleanest prints.
The main maya and .obj file includes the unaltered pieces, if you don't want to print them split.

description_text:
A 3D model of Tyrannosaurus rex, one of the largest terrestrial carnivores of all time!
I made him in Blender, modeled vertex by vertex with sculpted details. The model is fully rigged and animatable, with a functional armature and a very precise spine rig. This rex is mostly accurate to how it might have been in life, but still has a few fictionalized elements. The T-rex specimen Stan heavily influenced its creation. Not only is it rigged, but it also has a tension maps that simulate skin wrinkles as well as displacement maps for the larger scales and tarsal scutes. It has 4k diffuse, normal, bump, and roughness maps, and a scale alpha map (made by Damir G. Martin) for the smaller scales across the body.
This 3D model is royalty free, so feel free to use this for any commercial use as long as proper credit is given.

description_text:
Hi there! We are excited to present our new product. This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras.
Production: December, 2020
This is a true human size and detailed model of a beautiful adult woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in a uniform of a medical doctor. The model is captured in typical professional pose to perfectly match a variety of architectural and product visualizations, be used as a background or mid-sized character in advert banners, professional products/devices presentations, educational tutorials, VR/AR content etc.
The product is ready both for immediate use in architectural visualisations, or further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double 3d scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles)

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures: Diffuse, Normal, Specular maps

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable for 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you will find in the Tex folder, included into the main archive.
BONUSE: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus youll be able to make your own editing of the purchased 3d model.
ABOUT US: deep3dstudio is a 3d scanning studio based in Kyiv, Ukraine. We scan people, animals and objects. We also perform a full pipeline of post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, face blendshapes and animations.
Thank you for your purchase, we hope this model will be useful for your project!
Feel free to contact us if facing any questions. Your feedback is highly appreciated!
New 3d models every day!

description_text:
Human Skeleton 
Introducing our 3D Human Skeleton, an anatomically correct male skeleton model with proportions that match an average human. This model is a perfect tool for anyone studying anatomy, or for use as a base mesh for sculpting and rigging in various 3D projects.
The high-resolution models are sculpted in ZBrush and UV unwrapped for easy texturing. The texturing is done in Substance Painter, and the model is rendered in Marmoset Toolbag, ensuring that it is highly detailed and realistic.
This 3D Human Skeleton model is highly detailed, with accurate skeletal structures and realistic textures. It is perfect for use in medical and educational projects, as well as for use as a base mesh in character animation and game development. The model is also fully optimized for use in a variety of 3D software programs, making it easy to incorporate it into your projects.
Whether you're a student, a medical professional, or a 3D artist, this 3D Human Skeleton model is an essential tool for anyone studying or working with human anatomy. With its high-quality model, accurate proportions, and realistic texturing, it is the perfect addition to any collection of 3D models. So why wait? Download your 3D Human Skeleton model today and start creating stunning, realistic renders of the human anatomy!
Detail:

  - 206 Bones named.

  - Polygon count: 3,04,385.

  - Color coded all landmarks and different bones.

  - Major bones are labeled.

  - 4K Texture Maps.(BaseColor,Roughness,AO,ID,Normal,Curvature,Position,Thickness,WS Normal)

This pack contains:

  - ZBrush 2020 file (.ZTL)

  - Maya 2020 file (.ma, .mb)

  - Marmoset Toolbag file (.tbscene)

  - FBX

  - OBJ

The word pool comes from the Latin pisces fish and was originally used to designate wells for fresh or salt water fish. It was also used to designate the water tanks connected to the aqueducts. Indeed, before the invention of treatment plants, in swimming pools, bathing or decorative, outdoors, fish were used to clean the water, since they ate the larvae of insects, and that's where the name comes from.

Today I decided to create so easy thing , so I planned to create a 3d sword with some ornament , but it appears that this sword never wanted to be created , every step I do was leading to a disaster mistake , until at last I said I will not create this sword today , but I must create some thing instead , so I opened pexologic Zbrush 4r7 and started to think quickly to create a new figure Idea or toy like the dolphin I uploaded yesterday , so I remembered a toy was so famouse when I was 4 or 5 years old , but now I am 29 years old , so this toy was a little ball with a funny face can be filled with water and spray it by squeezing it and it was looking so nutty although it was so boring that when my dad baught me one I felt that I have been tricked , because we were in a feast and the only thing I was loving about feast is that we can purchase toys , also because I was the only son then .
So I wanted to day to create a funny ball with a funny face and big tong out of it's mouth by Zbrush , and while I was creating and sculpturing it , suddenly it looked like a funny chest armor , so I tried to create a cartoon alien figure that wearing his armor , but while creating it I found it leaning so much then I lost my well to fix it , so I decided to create any head of a cartoon character with a base under it to be a cartoon figure .
So I wanted this character that I did not decide what will it be yet be with a long nose , so I did it , and did they eyes holes and I made it mouth looking like a laughing mouth and decided that it will be a lizard head , but while creating it suddenly my bloods started to boil to create a fall body of this character , so I dead and created the texture and displacement and finally I decided that this lizard grow to become a dinosaur , may be because I watched so many videos about dinosaurs yesterday , and I made it as a toy while it contains so much polygons , a high poly product I mean , but be ware guys , you would wish to become kid and have such a toy to play with it when you see it .

description_text:
Aang from 'Avatar - The Last Airbender' is one of my favorite characters. This rig is a cartoony version of Aang modeled fully in polygons, and comes with an animatable glider/staff. The rig is made in Maya 2018.7, and will let you animate the character's body and face. Textures are in the PNG format. The zip file comes with a project folder, so please set the project for the textures to show. There's also a surprise waiting for you in the pack! Read on.
Features of the rig:

  - FK-IK spine that allows you to squash and stretch.

  - FK-IK stretch arms and legs.

  - Intuitive finger control system for the entire hand as well as individual digits.

  - A rigged glider/staff and can be animated using simple controllers.

  - 'Avatar State' allows for tattoos and eyes to glow.

  - Model is fully UV unwrapped, textured and comes with Arnold materials.

  - Detailed facial setup includes facial sliders and on-face sliders.

  - Character can be scaled up or down.

  - The rig comes with a Motion Capture asset that can be used with Mixamo to slap animations on. Here's a demo for it: https://youtu.be/eJPjR3Y0kCE

NOTES:

  - All materials are created to render with the Arnold renderer. Textures can be used with other software such as Marmoset.

  - MoCap files are available in the 'assets' folder.

  - Other pertinent details can be found in the enclosed FAQ.txt.

Please leave a rating/feedback for the item. Hope you enjoy your rig!

  - v1.04: Initial Release

  - v1.05: MoCap files had an issue where the eyes, teeth and tongue were disconnected with the rig. This issue is now fixed.

  - v1.06: DQ weights in the upper arm were fixed, IK foot has a ball controller now.

now the mandalorian have more cuts for optimize and better print.cuts in the arms right and left and lower leg right and left too, adding to the initial cuts of the head, torso and legs.
a new high quality diorama for 3D printing that we added to the hiko collection.

each figure is divided and optimized for a comfortable print with very little supports.
Elements such as the pit droid, toolbox and scurrier were added to give a better narrative to the diorama (droid and scurrier bring their version in one piece to be printed)
Each figure has its order of perfectly understandable files to arrive and print, images are also attached.
I hope you like this beautiful diorama, and enjoy the printing
The Mandalorian is an American space Western streaming television series created by Jon Favreau for Disney+. It premiered with the service's launch in November 2019, and is the first live-action series in the Star Wars franchise. It begins five years after the events of Return of the Jedi (1983) and stars Pedro Pascal as the title character, a lone bounty hunter who is hired to retrieve The Child.
Star Wars creator George Lucas began development on a live-action Star Wars television series by 2009, but the project was deemed too expensive to produce. After he sold Lucasfilm to Disney in October 2012, work on a new Star Wars series began for Disney+. Favreau signed on in March 2018, serving as writer and showrunner. He executive produces alongside Dave Filoni, Kathleen Kennedy, and Colin Wilson. The series' title was announced in October 2018 with the start of filming at Manhattan Beach Studios in California. Visual effects company Industrial Light & Magic developed the StageCraft technology for the series, using virtual sets and a 360-degree video wall to create the series' environments. This has since been adopted by other film and television productions.

description_text:
Hi there! We are excited to present our new product. This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with 200D cameras.
Production: February, 2021
This is a true human size and detailed model of a beautiful young woman of African appearance dressed in a surgical uniform. The model is captured in typical professional pose to perfectly match a variety of architectural and product visualizations, be used as a background or mid-sized character in advert banners, professional products/devices presentations, educational tutorials, VR/AR content etc.
The product is ready both for immediate use in architectural visualisations, or further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double 3d scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles)

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures: Diffuse, Normal, Specular maps

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable for 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you will find in the Tex folder, included into the main archive.
BONUSE: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus youll be able to make your own editing of the purchased 3d model.
ABOUT US: deep3dstudio is a 3d scanning studio based in Kyiv, Ukraine. We scan people, animals and objects. We also perform a full pipeline of post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, face blendshapes and animations.
Thank you for your purchase, we hope this model will be useful for your project!
Feel free to contact us if facing any questions. Your feedback is highly appreciated!
New 3d models every day!

VIBIEFFE Class 680 armchair
Seating system consisting of different elements featuring the very same technical charateristics but unlike concepts and looks. description_text:
33 (+1 Bonus) High poly sculpts of Jaws & Mouths: ZBrush subtool & IMM Brush, OBJs and FBX
This time around the teeth interlock better and are polygrouped for quick and easy masking to open or close them.
A great springboard for ideas - quickly spice up 3D sculpting/designing/concepting, or even augment and change existing sculpts. Included is a Zbrush insert mesh brush housing all of the jaws, a Zbrush master file with all the jaws as separate subtools (organised and polygrouped), FBX and OBJ files. These are untextured high poly sculpts.
All have been decimated as much as possible without sacrificing detail.
Here is a video demonstrating how I like to use it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LW1LwEzeX-w
Lots of love went into this one (more than usual) !
Made with Zbrush 2019.1

description_text:
This is my Darth Vader model, which I have spent a great deal of time working on. I tried to make it as accurate as possible but still having some of my own touch in it. An example would be the materials and the helmet. I gave the armor a brushed metal look, which in my opinion looks much better. And for the helmet, I mainly took aspects from empire strikes back, star wars: rebels, and clone wars. 
This model is fully rigged and ready to be made into art or animations of your creation. The legs are setup as IK while everything else is FK. Included also, is a video on how to use the cape for those of you who are not familiar with working with the physics tab.
In addition, I exported this model into several formats. Which include OBJ,FBX,DAE,3DS,Blender 2.82, and yes Blender 2.79. I put into two different versions of blender since the formats are very different so you can have the option of choosing which one you want to use. There is no difference between the two, so you do not need to worry about choosing between the two. 
I have added several preview images so you can get a good look at my model, and see how well you like it before you buy.
I hope you appreciate this model, and all the work I have put into it. :)

description_text:
The immediacy of the Single Basket Lamp draws anyone's attention. Its essential form was developed by Stephen in a small basket weaving community outside of Thies, the second city of Senegal. Given the fact that all Senegalese sweetgrass baskets are uniquely woven in form, color and pattern from a collective memory passed down for generations, Stephen was the first in this community to teach the weavers to work from a drawing. The resulting iconic pendant lamp is available with and without a diffuser to showcase it's simple, yet beautiful pattern language and technique inside and out. Prototyped and developed as part of the Studio Museum exhibition, Stephen Burks Man Made, 2011.
This model is Stephen Burks Man Made studio approved and is a precise replica of the real item.
Polygon model of Single Basket Lampof Stephen Burks Man Made Senegalese Collection. Ready for close-up rendering, uses V-Ray materials.

3ds MaxWRLJPG texture

Three variations of model (different  clothes and colors).
Clean topology based on quads.
All models is completely UVunwrapped.
High-poly, water tight models are suitable for color or monochrome 3d printing (WRL files).

Model is fully skinned.
T pose model is fully suitable for games and animations.
Low-poly model (MAX format) contains 12k polygons.
If required additional file formats or content can be provided.

description_text: In Morocco, the Gnawa, descendants of former black slaves from sub-Saharan Africa (Mali, Sudan, ...), practice around master musicians, instrumentalists (graqeb), clairvoyants (chouaafa, rarifa), mediums and followers. Their main instrument is a lute-drum with 3 strings: the goumbri (or hajhouj). On rhythms and heady sounds, trances take place for hours. Women perform guedra (strange southern dance) in a convulsive manner. The guedra is also the name of the drum that accompanies the dance. The women crumble on the last beat of music, the body shaking with spasms. During the dance, the men jump very high and seem to walk on embers when they are on the ground. The gnawa have created an original mystico-religious musical genre, mixing dikr (invocation of Allah) and madh (panegyric songs)

 Spike is an Israeli fourth generation[4] man-portable fire-and-forget anti-tank guided missile and anti-personnel missile with a tandem-charge HEAT warhead, developed and designed by the Israeli company Rafael Advanced Defense Systems.
As well as engaging and destroying targets within the line-of-sight of the launcher (fire-and-forget), some variants of the missile are capable of making a top-attack profile through a fire, observe and update guidance method;[4] the operator tracking the target, or switching to another target, optically through the trailing fiber-optic wire (or RF link in the case of the vehicle-mounted, long-range NLOS variant) while the missile is climbing to altitude after launch. This is similar to the lofted trajectory flight profile of the US FGM-148 Javelin.[citation needed]

CG StudioX Present :Red Shirt  lowpoly/PBR
Hello Everyone :
  - This is low ploy Red Shirt.

  - There are two set  of  presentation images one using V-Ray and the other using Marmoset Toolbag 3 (the logo of Marmoset Toolbag 3 added to the bottom right to the photos rendered with it )

Features :
  - Comes with Specular and Metalness PBR texture .

  - Comes with V_Ray texture for both Maya and 3ds Max.

  - Low polygon geometry.

  - The Model is prefect for game for both Specular workflow as in Unity and Metalness as in Unreal engine .

  - The model is good for any industry (film or Advertisement).

  - The model rendered using V-Ray 3.60 for both Maya and 3ds Max and it has the full texture for the scene.

  - The model also rendered using Marmoset Toolbag 3 with both Specular and Metalness PBR and also included in the product with the full texture.

  - All photo in the presentation images for the low poly (no dividing applied).

  - The scene file for the 3ds Max and Maya has back GEO , studio light and hdri added to it , that also included.

  - The model has 8k texuture so it's very good for film and Advertisement ,just subdivide the model and for game. industry ,it's good for cinematic but in real time engine, you will need to reduce the size of texture.

  - The model has ID map so you can change any information on the texture set very easy and quickly.

  - System unit: cm (Max, Maya).

  - The Product is ready to render, lights,textures ,materials and cameras included in the files.

Texture :
  - ALL Textures are 8k (8192*8192)

  - Albedo -Normal-Metalness -Roughness-Gloss-Specular-ambient occlusion-ID [ PBR textures ]

  - Diffuse-Normal-Reflection-Height-ior-Glossiness-Mask_button-AO-hdr [ V-Ray textures ]

Files :
  - Marmoset Toolbag 3 file has the model and the this texture included [Albedo -Normal-Metalness -Roughness-Gloss-Specular-ambient occlusion-ID].

  - The V-Ray file for max or Maya has this texture included [Diffuse-Normal-Reflection-Height-ior-Glossiness-Mask_button-AO-hdr].

  - OBj has also texture included for both Specular and Metalness PBR.

  - The Fbx file has no texture with it .

  - Zbrush file (the high poly of the model).

  - The overlapping in the uv is for some of the button of the shirt only.

Hello Every one , I know I took so long time because I was trying to create a 3D face of famouse character , and I admit it , it was so hard and doesn't go as I wish always but the one who said doing nothing is the best wasn't wrong , because after I felt tired and leaved the work and opened the character on the next day I found it so close , so I knew it was just the tire and anger blinded me from seeing this , so here are my advices to all of those who work with 3D : Give your self time and relax because some times the solution may be hidden before your eyes in your blindess that based on stress .
By the way , there is some one who purchased a product from me just now , his name is Haraldkos , so thank you Haraldkos for purchasing my product Allon the smily face alien . 
Then I think after the hard times happiness comes , I am gouing to tell you a tale for this .Once before there was a king who has a very beautiful daughter , when the princess grown up so many nobel men wished to marry her , but every one try she ask him some quetsion where is the mind ? , so the man point on his head and say here , so she refuse him , her dad the king felt sad for this and said why do you always ask this quetsion and refuse the answer although it is correect ? She reply this is not the correct answer I seek dad , until one day a poor bigger man was resting in front of the palace and she saw him , then she gave her maid a 30 eggs , 7 breads and a bottle of juice and told her to give them to the poor man after asking him 3 quetsions :1-How many days on the month ?2-How many days on the week ?3-Is the water of the sea deep or shallow ?The maid did as she said and asked the poor man , then he looked at the food and said there are 27 days per month , 6 days per week and the water of the sea is shallow , the maid returned and told the answers to the princess , then the princess said Say the truth or I will command the gaurds to whip you , the maid said I will say the truth , the princess asked what did you eat from the food I commanded you to give to the poor man ? , the maid said 3 eggs , 1 bread and some of the water .The princess rushed to her father and said I will marry this poor man , the king was shocked but she was his only kid so he couldn't refuse her demmand and they married , but he make the poor man one of the leaders of his army , and one day he sent him on a mission while the princess was pregnant by his kid , but he have been captured and didn't return .So many years have passed and the princess beared a son and the son grew up and became an adult man and he was sleeping near the princess in the bed , until one day his father broke out of his prison and returned , so he was shocked when he saw him sleeping near his wife so he picked up his sword and was about to slash him , so the princess shouted Halt , what are you doing ? Where is the mind ? .So he replied " The mind is in the paitience .So be paitient guys , because whatever you grow there are always a lot to learn and a lot of problems to meet you , because the life without battles is a game without victories  , and for example the character of today is the famouse Mohamed Salah , the video is not mine and the ubiform , I am not so fan with soccer but I really love Mohamed salah , not because his skills as because of his manners , and I am also Egyptian so this is another reason .Thank you guys for reading , and I will see you in the next product , take care .

description_text:
This is a 3D model of the side/shoulder gaskets of a Halo Reach Spartan and is meant for 3D printing for cosplay.
Almost no 3d models of Halo suits have this extremely important feature. The shoulder gaskets are a very important part of the armor, and without it, oftentimes people's armor looks incomplete.
This design is made to fit perfectly into NerdForgeDesign's chest armor files, and fill the large gap in the side of the chest with the actual armor that is supposed to go there. However, this does fit with a lot of other armors out there, even non-Halo Reach Armors, with a small amount of tweaking.
Just to clarify, only the Shoulder gasket is made by me and included in this purchase. The other armor showed here is what it is made to go with, and can be found at NerdForgeDesign on etsy or fletchasketch3 on cg trader.

description_text:
Grabber is a man-made robot that provides people with medicine, tool, and food supplies. The risk of the pandemic escalated so quickly that no one is allowed to leave their home. Some of them even spend their time in the bunkers, so it’s the Grabber’s duty to ensure them with everything they need.
MeshEvery component of the robot's body is a standalone object that has its own origin set to its geometry. I have applied the bevel modifier and set the shading to smooth.
UVsAs the objects are not connected, I have selected them all, turn into edit mode, select all, and UV unwrap. That way I came up with all the uv's into one big texture.
MaterialsThere are 6 materials which you will find on the .blend file. Every component is set to their material acordingly so you don't have to change anything else.
RigThe robot isn't rigged or animated. I'm in the process of doing that so I guess the animation will come in the future.

description_text:
PLEASE READ!!!!
Hi guys! How are you doing?Today I bring to you this amazing sci-fi drone wich I've decided to call SF-45080, a machine-like name you know. I've been making this for a long time, maybe 'cause I got other things to do and so on, whatever I hope you could enjoy it, the specs are below and any question or doubt you may have, have no problem in contact me. See you!
The meshes were all made in Blender 2.8, that includes modeling, texturing, rigging, animations and final renders for preview.Both consist of many loose parts but in the same object.
Highpoly mesh:
-138920 vertices-274517 edges-135705 faces-55 ngons-Mostly quads
Lowpoly mesh:
-13351 vertices-25623 edges-12385 faces-24 ngons-Mostly quads
The formats included are:
-Unity project (Version 2020.3.4)-Blender 2.92-Blender 2.8-FBX-OBJ-DAE
The Unity project attached with the model already imported and with materials created.
The textures are in tiff or png format (not both). The lowpoly one (wich is intended for games) has packed uvs, and the highpoly one has more ordered uvs. 
Low Poly textures 1textureset (2K and 4K):
-Color -Metalness-Roughness-Emission-Normal-Metalness(R)/Glossiness(A) (For unity)
High Poly textures 1textureset (4K and 8K):
-Color -Metalness-Roughness-Emission-Normal
The rig is mostly IK and you'll need just a few bones to animate the model. It is made in blender and therefore it'll work best in that software, altough there are animations included in the fbx, obj and dae files.The rigs for the lowpoly and the highpoly are slightly different, but overall they work the same way. Since the model has cables that move, I've used spline IK curves for that purpose. 
You can download the DRONE_SF-45080.zip wich includes all the files, or you can download the separate formats.

description_text: Born in Callander, Scotland, Destro's full name is James McCullen Destro XXIV, and he is Laird of the Castle Destro in the Scottish Highlands. Destro was an early investor in Macau and has other potentially lucrative speculative real estate holdings in developing areas of the world. War is his business and passion; Destro believes in the spoils of war and the vast wealth M.A.R.S. provides.[2] He hires mercenaries to stir up conflict in dangerous regions, then provides high-tech arms to any side able to meet his price. description_text:
This is supposed to be a semi realistic monster. I retopologies it and UV-unwrapped it. The multi-res modifier has a subdivision level of five, but you can change it for faster render time and if you don´t need the amount of detail, plus you can sculpt on top of it if you’d like to and your own detail to it. The model is equipped with a hair-particle system for a little extra realism. I´ve used a simple rig for movement, it is equipped with an IK-system on the arms, legs, and hip for easier and faster animation flow. The eyes and the blade of the saw are rigged with empties instead of bones. The blade is equipped with an object constrain in which it limits the rotation on the axes the blade can rotate in. 
Hope you enjoy.

description_text:
Smooth Criminal" is a song by American singer Michael Jackson from his 1987 album Bad. First broadcast on television as a video in early October 1988, it was released as the album's seventh single on October 21, 1988, and peaked at number seven on the Billboard Hot 100.[3] It was re-released on April 10, 2006, as a part of the Visionary: The Video Singles box set. The re-released Visionary single charted at number 19 in the UK. The song is one of Jackson's signature songs, and has appeared on numerous greatest hits albums.
The song contains a fast-paced beat intertwined with Jackson's lyrics about a woman named Annie, who has been violently attacked in her apartment by a smooth assailant.
The song serves as the theme song to Jackson's 1988 film Moonwalker, and plays as the background soundtrack in a section of the video game Michael Jackson's Moonwalker.

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built  3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This model was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized via ZRemesher within Zbrush. It has animation ready topology wrapped on top of the scan in Wrap3. 
This is a true human size detailed model of a sporty beautiful young woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in casual style together with detailed model of a red wool coat with visible buttons and stitches.  The coat can be separated, it is suitable for average model of size S, M, L and also may be slightly adjusted for better fitting. The model is captured in the A-pose with mesh ready for rigging and animation in all most usable 3d software.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, inside Game Engines or for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - fully quad topology

  - sufficiently clean

  - edge Loops based

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map 

  - non-overlapping UV map

  - ready for animation

Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. 
This is a true human size and detailed model of a young beautiful woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in a uniform of a medical doctor. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of architectural visualization, background character, product visualization, e.g. advert banners, professional products/devices presentations, etc.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - decimated model (100k triangles) 

  - sufficiently clean

  - PBR textures 8K diffuse, normal, specular maps 

  - non-overlapping UV map

Download package includes Cinema 4D project file with Redshift shader, as well as OBJ, FBX files, which are applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc. All the textures you may find in Tex folder, included into the main archive. 
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) clean and retopologized automatically via ZRemesher 3d model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

description_text:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built  3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras. This model was processed through Reality Capture and retopologized via ZRemesher within Zbrush. It has animation ready topology wrapped on top of the scan in Wrap3. 
This is a true human size detailed model of a sporty beautiful young woman of Caucasian appearance dressed in casual style. The model is captured in the A-pose with mesh ready for rigging and animation in all most usable 3d software.
The product is ready for immediate use in architectural visualisations, inside Game Engines or for further render and detailed sculpting in Zbrush.
Technical characteristics:

  - digital double scan model

  - low-poly model

  - fully quad topology

  - sufficiently clean

  - edge Loops based

  - ready for subdivision

  - 8K texture color map 

  - non-overlapping UV map

  - ready for animation

  - PBR textures 8K/4K resolution: Normal, Displacement, Albedo maps

  - Cinema 4d project file and redshift shader included. You can find all PBR textures in tex folder inside cinema 4d project folder.

Download package includes OBJ file, which is applicable to 3ds Max, Maya, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, Unity, Blender, etc.
BONUS: in this package you will also get a high-poly (.ztl tool) of raw 3d scanned model in zBrush, thus you’ll be able to make a super-cool editing of the purchased product.
ABOUT US: we are photogrammetry studio based in Kyiv, passionate about 3D world. We do full body scanning, 3D scanning for VFX and Gaming, as well as post-production, including model clean-up and rigging, hair and clothes reconstruction and simulation, deep PBR texturing, set of expressions ready for blending. Most of all we love to create a character from scratch. We transform your idea into high quality animation-ready 3D model with PBR texture set. So stay tuned and follow us! 
More scans released every week!
3D EVERYTHING

Model has been made using a 210 camera photogrammetry array. RAW scandata is not optimized for fast renders, so the model has been cleaned, retopologized, polygrouped and UV'mapped. This results in a comprehensively layed out texture map and clean mesh. The mesh is watertight and can be 3D printed.
Extra details about the model:
OBJ and FBX file formats are provided Texture map has dimension 8192x8192px (8k) and has the JPEG format (low compression)

description_text:
Hail Brethren!
You've traveled long but your Saga is only just beginning.
Have you been searching for the perfect set of heroes to use in your RPG, Adventure, or Story game? Well seek no further friend, the Mutiny Bros' Shard Saga: Fantasy Hero Pack has all the imagination and creative ingredients needed to cook up the tastiest of game brew stews.
The Shard Saga art style is cute, playful and low poly but don't let that fool you. Each hero weights in at roughly 2k polygons. They even have fingers! These heroes are capable of articulating at high levels of animation fidelity making this pack great to use for any platform you have in mind.
The Shard Saga: Fantasy Hero Pack has 44 different animations to use for your customized heroes. The following animations have been included and can be shared across every hero:
5 Animation Setsincluding attacks, idles, walks, runs, jumps, and deaths.-Unarmed-Sword-Staff-Hammer-Crossbow 
This pack contains a crazy amount of customization potential too. You will be able to mix and match a variety of bodies, heads and weapons to create HUNDREDS of different hero combinations. You will be choosing from:
54 Bodies-6 armor types-3 tiers per type-3 levels per tier
204 Heads-5 hair styles-2 skin colors-5 hair colors
75 Weapons-5 weapon types-3 tiers per type-5 levels per tier
No Textures! That's right, everything in this pack is vertex color and uses only one material making sure performance is never an issue. Do you want to use your own shader? No problem! Any shader that supports vertex color can be used.
Do you have suggestions for future packs in the Shard Saga universe? Email contact@mutinybros.com or feel free to tweet us @MutinyBros #ShardSaga
Mutiny Bros. Appreciates Your Dedication.

Real materials were used to create these maps. The maps will allow you to achieve photorealistic results when creating clothing with Marvelous Designer, Blender or 3D studio Max.
All maps tile seamlessly.

description_text:
Digital sculpture of a Lion Anatomy.
General Features:
Includes detailed Skeleton and Muscular System.Includes the high-poly sculpted model in Zbrush, with subdivision levels.Includes Baked Normal Maps Textures.Includes UVs in 8 UDIMs.Also includes Face Muscles, although not visible in renders to also show the Skeleton.Low-Poly Version is 118972 Vertices.High-Poly Version is 26000000 Vertices.Includes also LowRes meshes (lowest subdivision level.)Can be used for 3D printingSculpted in real life scale 1:1.Included Files & Formats:
.ZPR (Zbrush 2020) – Sculpted meshes with subdivision levels.
.BLEND (Blender 2.82) – Render-Ready with materials
.OBJ – Low-Poly meshes
.PNG – Baked Normal Maps with UDIMs Setup
Notes:
This is a highpoly digital sculpture. The model includes UVs and Materials.This model was created by studying image references, mainly the Atlas of Animal Anatomy for Artists. This model was created with Zbrush 2020.The preview images were rendered with Blender Cycles. The .blend file includes a basic rendering setup: Geometry, Materials, Lights.The LowRes meshes were created using Zbrush’s Zremesh.

Procedural Materials
Materials created using procedural blender nodes. That gives unlimited possibilities in resizing without any loss of quality.
Iris Colors
40 color presets and an infinite amount that you can create.
Pupil Shapekeys
12 shapekeys that provide opportunities to create a wide variety forms of the Pupil.
What you get
Blender file in which two models with materials: sclera and iris-pupil.
Write your desires about extra forms for the Pupil.
Update 1.1 : Smaller Iris Size

description_text:
A model of a 3-wheel stroller.This is a more rugged stroller for when you need to take your baby or toddler off-road. Though keep in mind that in exchange for the sturdiness, this stroller doesn't include a cup holder or extra pouches.
Includes the following formats:

  - Poser

  - DAZ Studio

  - Wavefront obj

  - 3ds

Product Features (Poser):

  - Poser figure: obj, cr2/ png, with 3,874 polygons.

  - Hood can rotate or be hidden/ shown.

  - All wheels can rotate, with an ERC dial on the Body.

Materials:

  - Includes 9 material presets to change the color of the hood, plastic, and seat:

  - Black

  - Blue

  - Gray

  - Green

  - Orange

  - Peach

  - Purple

  - Red

  - Yellow

Textures:
  - Includes one fabric bump map with Poser shaders.
Designed for use in Poser 6 and above.
Product Features (DAZ Studio):

  - DAZ prop figure: dsf, duf/ png, with 3,874 polygons.

  - Hood can rotate or hidden/ shown.

  - All wheels can rotate, with a Pose Control dial on the Body.

Materials:

  - Includes 9 material presets to change the color of the hood, plastic, and seat:

  - Black

  - Blue

  - Gray

  - Green

  - Orange

  - Peach

  - Purple

  - Red

  - Yellow

Textures:
  - No textures needed: all materials use Iray shaders, including plastic, reflective metal, and rubber.
Designed for use in DAZ Studio 4.9 and above with Iray.
Product Features (Wavefront obj/ 3ds):

  - Approx 3,874 polygons.

  - Made entirely with 3 and 4 point polygons.

  - Includes group information, which your software should interpret as separate parts, which includes:

  - 1 front wheel

  - 2 rear wheels

  - Hood

  - Although the model includes these parts, this version of the model is not rigged.

  - Includes logically named materials, such as Tires, Plastic, Metal, and Fabric. This makes it very easy to recolor the model.

  - The model has basic UV mapping and a fabric bump map is included. You'll need to apply your own shader to the metal materials.
